system.description:
Favoured weapon: Pick, Heavy

Granted power: Advantage on Intimidation. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it, and your Smite deals +1d6 damage of that type.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Tiamat in the World of Arneyan wiki.
